# Tracker Views

Useful baseline views are:

1. Ready to work: `Ready` and `In progress`, sorted by Priority.
2. By release: grouped by Target release, including unscheduled work.
3. Initiatives: top-level items without a parent.

Add blocked or assigned-to-me views only when they answer a recurring need.
Verify each view against the live project items; an accepted filter that
matches nothing is a configuration failure, not an empty backlog.
